channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jason Kidd | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jason Kidd from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Jason Kidd, Luka Doncic
item.description:
“I don’t have a particularly high opinion of him. Perhaps the best illustration is that, after working with Jason Kidd for a year, I sat down with him and said, ‘Look, I have a history with Luka Doncic and I know him well, we’ve worked together before, and that can certainly help the team, but I am not here working for Luka Doncic, I am working for you, this is your team.’ However, he could never really get over it. It was something in his head, part of his personal issues, which I didn’t want to get involved in,”

Igor Kokoskov on Jason Kidd, Luka Doncic, Sep 15, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Madison Square Garden on Vince Carter, Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, New Jersey
item.description:
“… I grew up, obviously, in Jersey, obviously it was so much easier for me to get New Jersey Nets tickets and see Kenyon Martin, Vince Carter, Jason Kidd, but my family has always had such respect and love for the Knicks and my father having ties to the Knicks, it was kind of guaranteed I was going to fall into this world of being a Knicks fan growing up.”

Madison Square Garden on Vince Carter, Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, New Jersey, May 30, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Masai Ujiri on parting ways with Jason Kidd:

“Jason has had a meaningful impact on the Dallas Mavericks, both as a Hall of Fame player and as the head coach who helped lead this franchise back to the NBA Finals. We are thankful for Jason’s leadership, his professionalism and his commitment to the team. In my short time here, I’ve developed an enormous amount of respect for what he has built. He will always be an important part of the Mavericks family.”

Masai Ujiri on Jason Kidd, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Jason Kidd
item.description:
After contemplating briefly, 19-year-old Cooper Flagg respectfully admitted he wasn’t well versed on the Naismith Basketball Hall of Famer who is also the rookie’s head coach with the Dallas Mavericks.

“I’m not extremely familiar. I know he’s a legend, but no. I didn’t watch J-Kidd a ton,”

Cooper Flagg on Jason Kidd, Mar 7, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Khris Middleton on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Khris Middleton on playing under Jason Kidd in Milwaukee:

“Hecaught me at an early age where he was able to teach me a lot — the way he saw the game, the way he approached the game & how to be a professional, on & off the court. He was very important of how my career turned out. I’m happy to be playing for him again.”

Khris Middleton on Jason Kidd, Feb 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Vince Carter on Jason Kidd
item.description:
“But knowing J-Kidd like I do, that answer I got I could tell you he was going to say that. (Kidd) understands because he plays the game. He’s played with superstars of all facets at all positions that could do all things.”

Vince Carter on Jason Kidd, Dec 13, 2025. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Jason Kidd
item.description:
“Just kind of what J-Kidd and Nico have been telling me to do all summer, so I’ve been texting these guys … and trying to get them ready for the season, especially with Kai’s out. “I know they’re used to him kind of being the leader, but I’ve kind of just taken on that role with the help of actually Klay (Thompson) as well, as being two of the three oldest guys on the team. We’ve got a group of fairly young guys. I’m just trying to give them knowledge that I have and try to lead them to success.”

Anthony Davis on Jason Kidd, Oct 3, 2025. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Jon Scheyer, Jason Kidd
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Cooper Flagg on Jason Kidd’s hopes to play him at PG next season for the #Mavs:

“I’m looking forward to it. Coach Scheyer trusted me a lot last year & I handled it a lot. I didn’t bring it up a ton, but in the halfcourt I handled it a lot & set up a lot of different actions. I think it’s something I can do at a high level so I’m excited to just experiment & do some new things”

Cooper Flagg on Jon Scheyer, Jason Kidd, Jul 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Jason Kidd
item.description:
“I definitely was blessed for what Coach Kidd and them put me through early on, Dallas giving me the ball and having me be able to be playmaker with the ball and off the ball whenever it was Kyrie starting or Luka was out or something like that,”

Quentin Grimes on Jason Kidd, Mar 14, 2025. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Vince Carter on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Vince Carter on his Nets tenure after playing for the Raptors:

“New life. The crazy thing about that is that I was criticized for it. It was strange because my role in Toronto was just give me the ball. I can get you a bucket… But then you have a guy who makes the game easier for you in Jason Kidd.”

Vince Carter on Jason Kidd, Jan 25, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Quentin Grimes told DallasHoopsJournal.com.

“I know I’m going to have a bigger opportunity to show that coming here. I feel like [Jason Kidd] and the coaches have put me in a good position to go out there and just play my game. Whether it’s coming out shooting the ball or making plays for my teammates, I just try to make the right play.”

Quentin Grimes on Jason Kidd, Jan 11, 2025. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Vince Carter on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Vince Carter on how much fun it was to run for years with Jason Kidd's #Nets:

“The thing that always baffled me was people were like ‘well how come he didnt do that for us in Toronto?’I never understood that, because I was like ‘It’s Jason freakin’ Kidd. Let's start there.’”

Vince Carter on Jason Kidd, Oct 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Mychal Thompson:

“Perfect fit. It’s going to be amazing. He’s going to have so many open shots. Luka and Kyrie are such great playmakers and draw so much attention. He’s going to fit in seamlessly with what Jason Kidd, Luka and Kyrie have going on down there.”

Mychal Thompson on Jason Kidd, Jul 3, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on Mavericks coach Jason Kidd calling him Boston’s best player:

“I don’t have no reaction. It’s a team game. I’m trying to focus on that. Everybody has their own opinions.”

Jaylen Brown on Jason Kidd, Jun 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Jason Kidd, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Jason Kidd saying Jaylen Brown is Boston’s best player:

“No reaction. This is a team sport. … We understand people try to drive a wedge between us. I guess it’s a smart thing to try to do. … This is not our first time at the rodeo.”

Jayson Tatum on Jason Kidd, Jaylen Brown, Jun 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Jason Kidd, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Tatum on Kidd saying Brown’s the Celtics best player:

“We wouldn’t be here without JB…People try to drive a wedge in between us. It’s a smart thing to try to do. We’ve been in this position for years, saying one of us should be traded…”

Jayson Tatum on Jason Kidd, Jaylen Brown, Jun 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @VinceGoodwill.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Harrison recalls when Kidd first reached out to him after Bryant’s death about getting aid from Nike for his budding girls AAU program.

“We sponsored them from the beginning. [Kidd] said, ‘I want to give back to girls basketball. The men are taken care of. We need more people supporting women.’ I told him we will help with whatever you need. He just started building and he is doing a hell of a job,”

Nico Harrison on Jason Kidd, Apr 12, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Speaking on the Forgotten Seasons podcast, Boston Celtics Hall of Famer Paul Pierce said that Jason was the best player in the world during the 2001-02 NBA season.

“I thought J-Kidd was the best player in the world in 2002,”

Paul Pierce on Jason Kidd, Mar 16, 2024. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Gary Payton on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jason Kidd, Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Detlef Schrempf, Damon Stoudamire, Bonzi Wells, Hersey Hawkins
item.description:
Payton shared with Poole and Johnson.

“We used to go fishing when my mom was pregnant with my brother. Detlef [Schrempf], Hersey [Hawkins]. Those were all of [Gary Sr.’s] teammates. Nate McMillan, Damon Stoudamire– [Jason] Kidd is like family, too. [Brian] Shaw is family. Big [Shaquille O'Neal]. Rest in peace Kobe [Bryant]. Kobe was around back then. I can literally go on. Bonzie Wells.”

Gary Payton on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jason Kidd, Brian Shaw, Nate McMillan, Detlef Schrempf, Damon Stoudamire, Bonzi Wells, Hersey Hawkins, Dec 19, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Tony Parker, Jason Kidd, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
Jackson said via Showtime.

“Speedy Claxton saved us. I don't know why they don't talk about Speedy Claxton and give him his props bro. Tony Parker was near the bench every fourth quarter because Steph [Stephon Marbury] was frying him. Jason Kidd was frying him.”

Stephen Jackson on Tony Parker, Jason Kidd, Stephon Marbury, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Jason Kidd
item.description:
“They’ve got to run more, and I think they did that when Luka was out and Kyrie was at the helm because they’re much better when they play faster. That’s how Jason Kidd wants to coach. He wants them to play faster, but when Luka’s in there, they can’t play fast. To me, if he’s in better shape and they can play fast, that puts more pressure on the opposing team.”

Reggie Miller on Jason Kidd, Apr 13, 2023. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“I don’t think it’s Kidd’s problem that we didn’t have an identity. ... The game changed in ways we didn’t expect it to change, so I blew it. It was on me, personally, because the game changed in terms of the take foul and the speed of the game.”

Mark Cuban on Jason Kidd, Apr 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @tim_cato.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, Kurt Thomas, Grant Hill
item.description:
Damian Lillard:

“When I came in the league, like Jason Kidd was starting for the Knicks and Grant Hill and Kurt Thomas and Kenyon Martin…it was real older dudes in the league,”

Damian Lillard on Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, Kurt Thomas, Grant Hill, Mar 14, 2023. Source: Uproxx.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Mark Cuban to me on addition of Kemba Walker:

“We wanted to add some flexibility to our offense. Like last year at this point, we have great shot quality, particularly from the 3, but we have struggled to make enough of them. Kemba will give J-Kidd more offensive flexibility.”

Mark Cuban on Jason Kidd, Nov 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Josh Green on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Callie Caplan:Josh Green on Jason Kidd saying he evaluates him more on detail than scoring stats:

“My first two years, I used to turn down a lot of shots. Now I try not to second-guess it. I shoot it if I’m open. But at the end of the day, it’s the little things that matter.”

Josh Green on Jason Kidd, Nov 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Callie Caplan:Steph Curry on history playing against Jason Kidd:

“I just remember him being an unbelievably sound point guard that I felt like never left the top of the key.... My favorite memory of him is all the reactions and mannerisms he had on the bench in New York when I was going off.”

Stephen Curry on Jason Kidd, May 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Monty Williams:

“I told Jason [Kidd], 'You guys got us. You kicked our butts.' That's life.”

Monty Williams on Jason Kidd, May 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Jason Kidd
item.description:
Callie Caplan:Frank Vogel on Jason Kidd’s first season with Mavs after two on his staff:

“I think he should be Coach of the Year. I don’t say that to get him fired. I say that out of love.”

Frank Vogel on Jason Kidd, Mar 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jason Kidd, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Cunningham:

“He's got 'it.' He's a talent. He's got that J-Kidd gene as far as understanding the game. Not saying he's J-Kidd, but that kind of savant as far as reading the floor, making plays.”

Dwane Casey on Jason Kidd, Cade Cunningham, Feb 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Jason Kidd, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Harrison:

“I’m actually excited about Kristaps. I think he’s finally healthy. What Jason Kidd is gonna bring in terms of communication and really wrapping his arms around people, I honestly think he’s going to really flourish in the system that Jason’s gonna bring.”

Nico Harrison on Jason Kidd, Kristaps Porzingis, Jul 18, 2021. Source: Dallas Morning News.
